Welcome to the Calendar app! 
During use, this app may access the network and requires the following permissions: 
Location - for providing Weather forecast function
Contacts - for providing Birthdays function
Installed packages list - for providing China Holiday function
To deny these access requests, deselect the check boxes.
Calendar will access data of your location/contacts/installed package list if you allow the access request.
Weather forecast and Birthdays functions might not work properly if you deny the access requests below.
